phaseB.rule: For Phase B only, resolve the selected overlay for exact fields, keys, bounds, snapshot proof, Project-serialized concurrency, delete-batch restore cohorts and typed receipts. The tables array below preserves the earlier 85-record broad proposal. No other record is overridden; no schema or code generation is authorized. Allocation state and graph ETag are derived; no graph-state table.
